summary: Improve signal timing, detector diagnosis, and corridor coordination with practical exercises. Review the course outline and plan your training.
lede: Traffic signal control training helps traffic engineers, signal operations staff, and transport supervisors assess intersection timing and address operational problems. The course develops skills in cycle-length and split analysis, detector diagnostics, and coordination review using Webster’s method, time-space diagrams, and controller event data; exercises lead to practical timing recommendations and performance reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, maintain, or make decisions about traffic signal timing and intersection operations. It suits intermediate-level practitioners with working familiarity with signalized intersections.
modules: Signal Control Context and Timing Plans
Signal Timing Action Plans and Reporting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with signalized intersections, traffic movements, and basic traffic operations is expected. No programming is required; spreadsheet skills support the event-data exercises.
